_partNote: Seven classes of drug, separated by silhouette rather than by chemistry, because at 74px only the outline survives: an open rod-and-sphere framework (small molecule), a Y (antibody), a vertical coil (protein), a horizontal comb (oligonucleotide), a long diagonal (syringe), a hard faceted ball (viral capsid), and a soft round cell. The two round subjects are the pair to watch — the capsid is a closed straight-edged polyhedron and the cell is a soft irregular blob with a nucleus inside it, so they read apart even small.

partPrompts.1: A ball-and-stick molecular model of a small drug molecule, seen three-quarter: two fused flat six-sided rings lying in a plane, built from evenly sized spheres joined by short straight rods, with four or five single spheres branching off the outer edges on their own rods. Open and airy, with plenty of empty space showing between the rods. Every sphere is the same pale color as every other one; no color coding of atoms. One compact object, drawn large and centered. Not a chain, not a coil, not a ribbon, nothing spiral anywhere, no vessel and no equipment.
partPrompts.2: A single antibody drawn as a bold letter Y, seen flat-on: two straight upper arms of equal length spreading symmetrically from a central junction, and one straight lower stem of similar thickness dropping from that junction, each of the three limbs drawn as a smooth tapered bar with a small rounded tip and a visible hinge notch where it meets the center. Simple, symmetrical, and drawn large enough that the Y fills the frame. One object only. No cells, no molecules floating around it, nothing it is attached to, no vessel and no equipment.
partPrompts.3: A protein alpha helix standing upright, seen three-quarter: one continuous flat ribbon of even width wound into a tall regular spiral of about six turns around an empty invisible axis, the turns evenly spaced so the gaps between them are clearly open, with a short straight length of the same ribbon leaving the top turn and another leaving the bottom turn. Tall, vertical, and clearly a coil. One object only; not a double strand, not a ladder, no rungs or cross-links between the turns, no spheres, no rods, no vessel and no equipment.
partPrompts.4: A short single strand of nucleic acid lying horizontally, seen flat-on: one smooth continuous backbone ribbon running left to right in a shallow wave, with about twelve short straight stubs of even length projecting from the same side of it at regular intervals, each stub ending in a small flat tab. It reads as a comb: one long spine with regular teeth along one edge. Horizontal and low. One strand only; not a double helix, no second backbone, no ladder rungs, nothing paired, no spiral, no vessel and no equipment.
partPrompts.5: A medical syringe lying at a diagonal across the frame, seen three-quarter: a plain smooth barrel with a flat finger flange at the back end, a plunger rod with a round thumb pad protruding behind the flange, a narrow tapered nose at the front, and a fine straight needle continuing from the nose to a beveled point. Drawn large so the long diagonal fills the frame. One object only. No vial, no hand, no droplet, no arm, no packaging, no vessel and no equipment.
partPrompts.6: An icosahedral virus capsid drawn as a single closed solid shell, seen three-quarter: a ball built entirely from flat triangular facets meeting at straight ridges, so the outline is a visibly faceted polygon rather than a smooth circle, with the near facets catching slightly different shading from the ones turning away. Hard-edged, geometric and completely closed. One object only, drawn large and centered; nothing inside it, no cutaway, no spikes, no tails, no fibers, no cell, no vessel and no equipment.
partPrompts.7: One immune cell drawn large and centered, seen three-quarter: a soft rounded body with a gently irregular, slightly lobed outline, a large kidney-shaped nucleus clearly visible as a distinct closed shape inside it, and a fringe of short soft microvilli around the whole rim so the edge reads as fuzzy rather than crisp. Soft and organic throughout. One cell only; no straight edges anywhere, no flat facets, no polygon, nothing geometric, no dish, no vessel and no equipment.
